tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground: the channel sidebar column and the sign-in page. Panels sit on it.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Server rail strip on the far left. Also the 2px ring around badges and status dots that sit on the rail.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels (conversation, side panel), the sign-in card and quick tiles.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Home tile and server buttons on the rail.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The current server button, the active channel row and the message action toolbar.

tokens.name: tab-active
tokens.usage: Selected segment of a segmented tab control.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside text inputs, the composer and the member search.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Segmented tab track behind the segments.

tokens.name: search-fill
tokens.usage: The sidebar search trigger (Search Acme ⌘K).

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Role tags next to a sender's name.

tokens.name: thread-chip
tokens.usage: Thread summary chip under a message, while its thread is closed.

tokens.name: reaction
tokens.usage: Reaction chip you have not reacted with (fill and border).

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Attachment cards and the parent message pinned atop a thread.

tokens.name: hover-row
tokens.usage: Hover on sidebar rows and the server-name button.

tokens.name: hover-message
tokens.usage: Hover on a message row.

tokens.name: hover-icon
tokens.usage: Hover on icon buttons (the glyph turns `ink-field`).

tokens.name: hover-member
tokens.usage: Hover on member rows.

tokens.name: hover-secondary
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a secondary button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel header rule, day divider, thread and side-panel rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Vertical divider in the channel header; border of the message action toolbar.

tokens.name: line-auth
tokens.usage: The 'or' rule on the sign-in card.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: 1px ring around quick tiles (as a box-shadow).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control borders in the side panel: member search, reply field, small secondary buttons. Light misses 3:1 on `surface` (source value, kept).

tokens.name: border-composer
tokens.usage: The composer's border. Light misses 3:1 on `surface` (source value, kept).

tokens.name: border-form
tokens.usage: Sign-in inputs and secondary buttons. Light misses 3:1 on `surface` (source value, kept).

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Quick tile ring on hover.

tokens.name: border-hover-form
tokens.usage: Secondary button border on hover.

tokens.name: border-active
tokens.usage: Composer and search border while focused within (focus-within).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Sign-in input border while focused, with the `ring-field` glow.

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: Dashed outline of the add-server button.

tokens.name: rail-divider
tokens.usage: The short rule between Home and the server list.

tokens.name: panel-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on panels and the sign-in card; visible in dark only.

tokens.name: underline
tokens.usage: Underline colour for quiet text buttons (Show 10 earlier replies).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: names, headings, unread channels. On `bg`, `surface`, `field`, `inset` and `chip`.

tokens.name: ink-selected
tokens.usage: Text of the active channel and the current server's monogram, on `raised`.

tokens.name: ink-field
tokens.usage: Typed text in inputs and the composer, secondary-button labels, and an icon button's glyph on hover. On `field`, `surface` and `hover-icon`.

tokens.name: ink-emphasis
tokens.usage: The name in the typing hint under the composer, on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Message text, quick tile labels, form labels. On `surface`, `inset` and `hover-message`.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Role-tag text on `chip`; checkbox labels, quiet text buttons and secondary copy on `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: ink-quiet
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, read channels, system lines, day-divider labels, footer links, the search trigger label. On `surface`, `bg`, `rail`, `track` and `search-fill`.

tokens.name: icon-strong
tokens.usage: Icon buttons inside the message action toolbar, on `raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, section labels, channel topics, member subtitles, placeholders. On `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: the # and lock glyphs of read channels (aria-hidden). Misses 4.5:1 by design (source value, kept); never for words.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill: send button, count badges, the primary button.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lumia blue. Primary fills: send button, count badges, primary button, current-server ring, the active channel's #, checkbox accent-color.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: reply counts, 'Wave hello', mentions, the New tag and divider label, a reaction you added. On `surface` and `accent-soft`; dark on `accent-soft` measures 4.49:1 (source value, kept).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `accent-ink`: mention chips, the New tag, your reactions, the open thread's chip.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: The 'New' unread divider rule.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the message whose thread is open in the side panel.

tokens.name: reaction-on-border
tokens.usage: Border of a reaction chip you have reacted with.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links (Forgot password?, Create an account). On `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Text links on hover.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: Online status dot; the member-joined icon. Light reads 2.99:1 on `bg` (source value, kept): always pair a dot with the status word, visible or screen-reader only.

tokens.name: away
